interface.invocation: one new time-ordered sample per input call
interface.output: one detection boolean and five non-negative isolation probabilities in order f_pic, f_pim, f_waf, f_iml, f_x
interface.no_fault_output: detection=false requires all five isolation values to be zero
interface.fault_output: detection=true requires the five isolation probabilities to sum to one within 1e-6
interface.missing_signal_policy: missing channels stay absent; no nominal-value imputation is provided by the contract

stream_invariants.recording_identity: one immutable recording identity per streaming session
stream_invariants.model_identity: one frozen model SHA-256 per streaming session
stream_invariants.sample_sequence: sample indices are contiguous and timestamps strictly increase
stream_invariants.model_error: poison session because hidden state may have changed before the error
stream_invariants.invalid_model_output: poison session and reject subsequent samples until explicit reconciliation/reinitialization
stream_invariants.sample_validation_error: reject before model invocation; session remains usable
stream_invariants.recovery: new session after a model-side error requires external reconciliation and an explicit new session identity

receipt.tamper_detection: recompute output and receipt digests and verify previous-receipt linkage in strict sample order
receipt.limitation: hash chaining provides integrity and ordering, not signer authentication, trusted timestamps, secure process isolation or proof that sensor bytes are truthful

required_adapter_gates: one Python/MATLAB Input(sample) call per official sample
exact boolean plus five-float output shape and class order
no output revisions after a sample returns
same model and calibration artifact digests as Rust core
golden-vector parity across Rust and adapter implementations
offline execution without unapproved licensed dependencies

hard_gates: exactly one output receipt per accepted input sample
no previous output can be modified by the streaming API
no future command, controller mode or retrospective annotation can enter the current prediction
non-monotonic and skipped sample indices fail before model invocation
invalid output and uncertain model errors poison the session
detection=false requires a zero isolation vector
detection=true requires a normalized five-class vector
unknown-fault probability remains represented in slot five
receipt chain binds model identity, input digest, output digest and prior receipt
hash integrity is not presented as signer authentication or physical truth
Python/MATLAB adapter compliance is separate from Rust-core contract compliance

research_targets_not_achieved.target: Zero input/output cardinality mismatches, sample gaps, historical-output mutations or probability-contract violations across the full frozen replay suite.
100% receipt-chain verification across deterministic replay of every accepted sample and exact model identity.
P95 per-sample end-to-end inference and receipt latency below 10 ms on declared reference hardware at 20 Hz input, without queue growth.
Exact output parity on all golden vectors between Rust core and Python/MATLAB competition adapter.

claim_ceiling: Rust source contract and synthetic tests only until exact-head compile/tests, public dataset audit, trained model run, and a compliant Python/MATLAB adapter are independently verified.
